हु r. 3rd cl. (जुहोति)
 1. To sacrifice, to offer in oblation, (sometimes
with the accusative of the deity honoured.)
 2. To eat.
 3. To take.
4. To please or satisfy.
 5. To throw or cast.

हु(हू)ङ्कार m. (-रः) Uttering a menacing sound, roaring, bellowing.
 E. हुन,
and कार making; also similar compounds, as हुङ्कृति, हुङ्कृत, &c.
हू Ind. An interjection of calling, of contempt, of pride, and of grief or weeping.
